semiconductor_relevance: High — Eternal Materials Co., Ltd. specializes in various materials essential for semiconductor manufacturing, including die attach compounds and photoresists.
summary: Eternal Materials Co., Ltd. develops and supplies advanced materials for the semiconductor industry, focusing on die attach compounds, encapsulation materials, and photoimageable materials. The company has received multiple awards for its innovation and contributions to industrial technology advancement.

regional_presence.Taiwan: Eternal has been recognized for its contributions to the semiconductor industry in Taiwan and has received multiple awards from local industry associations.
